title: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support - expression of interest (Clayton)
content_text: DTM Geocivil Consulting Pty Ltd (Clayton VIC) delivers geotechnical and civil engineering: geotechnical investigation, design of rigid and flexible pavements, construction working platforms and hardstands, testing and reporting, project management, civil engineering and construction services. Careers page verified 2026-10-03: Currently we don't have any open positions but if you are interested in possible future opportunities please send your CV to info@dtmgeocivil.com.au. Office 2/34 Hourigan Avenue, Clayton VIC 3168. Phone 1300 550 871.
apply_instructions: Email CV for future opportunities to info@dtmgeocivil.com.au as published on https://dtmgeocivil.com.au/career.html (no open positions listed).
